text:
maria: Kicking off observability provisioning for eu-north-4 GPU cluster — want a quick sanity-check + handoff. Focusing on logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alert templates. @ajay @sylvie @nate please ack and call out blockers.
ajay: Ack — I'll own the logs pipeline and retention. Quick Q: Vector or Fluentd for new nodes?
sylvie: Vector v0.27 by default for new regions. Fluentd only for legacy on-prem adapters. Use tenant eu-north-4.
ajay: Perfect. Plan: Vector -> Loki (ingest) + S3 archival (lifecycle 90d compressed). Will spin up vector daemonset and a promtail shim for old apps.
kevin: GPU capacity FYI: initial pool = 24 A10g-equivalent nodes (3 pods/node expected for inference lanes). Autoscaler min=8, max=48. Rough on-demand cost estimate ~€18k/mo; consider committed nodes for lower price.
sylvie: Network notes: ensure VPC endpoint for S3 and private egress to Redwood control-plane region (eu-west-1). Avoid NAT egress for bulk telemetry to cut cost.
infra-bot: terraform apply started for module=eu-north-4-observability at 1805123500. Plan: create VPC endpoints, EKS cluster obs namespace, vector daemonset, otel-collector, loki, prometheus, grafana.
nate: Tracing: deploy OpenTelemetry Collector as a deployment + headless svc. Config snippet (otel-collector.yaml):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  jaeger:
    endpoint: "jaeger.ingress.eu-north-4.svc.cluster.local:14250"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [jaeger]
```
Make sure collector forwards traces to jaeger and a sample to tempo for long-term storage.
kevin: Prometheus: use two replicas, persistent volume 500Gi (thanos sidecar planned later). ServiceMonitor for kube-state, node-exporter, and the inference-serving exporter. Retention 15d to start.
olivia: Grafana: create folder "eu-north-4 / inference" and import dashboards: inference-latency (id: 9823), kvcache-hitratio (custom), gpu-utilization (custom). Set templating variable cluster=eu-north-4.
maria: Alerts we need templates for (defaults + runbook links):
- Loki: high_ingest_rate -> ru: investigate app flood, throttle if needed
- Prometheus: node_disk_io_wait OR high_ptp_latency -> investigate network/storage
- GPU: gpu_memory_swap > 5% over 5m -> scale down batches or add nodes
- Serving: long_kvcache_miss_rate > 2% over 10m -> possible KV cache misconfig or model mismatch
- Tracing: otel_collector_restarts > 0 -> collector OOM or bad config
Please add runbook links in alert annotations.
kevin: Example alert rule (prometheus style):
```yaml
- alert: GPUHighMemorySwap
  expr: avg_over_time(gpu_memory_swap_percent[5m]) > 5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU memory swapping on {{ $labels.instance }}"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-swap"
```
ajay: Loki notes: tenant separation by region; ensure retention labels and tenant-quota set to 5GB/day to avoid runaway ingest. We'll also enable index dedup window 10m.
sylvie: Deployment checklist items I'm tracking:
1) VPC endpoints created and tested (S3, ECR)
2) Private route to control-plane endpoints
3) Vector daemonset deployed + config committed to repo (obs/vector/eu-north-4.toml)
4) Loki statefulset PVCs 
5) Prometheus + ServiceMonitors + alert rules
6) OTEL collector + Jaeger/Tempo integration
7) Grafana datasources and dashboards imported
8) RBAC + secrets reviewed (KMS/EKS IAM)
9) Smoke alerts and synthetic checks (latency/queries)
10) Cost/ingest guardrails (quotas/alerts)
maria: Network & security gotchas: double-check EKS ENI limits per node type (A10g packaging), and that prometheus scraping doesn't exceed cluster egress for heavy nodes. Also ensure no public ELBs for internal telemetry.
ops-bot: Smoke tests: vector -> loki ingest OK, prometheus targets 78/82, otel collector OK, grafana health ok. (timestamp:1805123650)
nate: One more: tracing retention. Jaeger storage for hot traces 7d, Tempo (S3) for 90d. Add lifecycle policy compress+archive after 30d.
kevin: Cost control: set Loki max_streams_per_user and per-tenant retention/quotas; enable sampling on OTEL for high-volume inference endpoints (default 10%).
ajay: Deployment command for infra team (example):
```
# apply observability infra
terraform workspace select eu-north-4 && terraform apply -var=\"region=eu-north-4\" -target=module.observability
```
Please run in the obs-automation account and tag resources with charge_code=eu-north-4.
maria: Handing off to eng-oncall @sylvie for post-provision verification. Please run the smoke playbook and confirm dashboards + alerts in 2 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sylvie: On it. I'll run the checklists and post results. :eyes:
infra-bot: terraform apply completed successfully at 1805123680. Resources created: VPC endpoints, EKS cluster eu-north-4, vector daemonset, prometheus, loki, grafana, otel-collector.
ops-bot: Post-provision synthetic checks: inference-latency synthetic request 95pct < 120ms, metric scrape latency < 2s, logs ingest < 1s. All green.
maria: Thanks team — marking this thread as the initial obs provision handoff for eu-north-4. I'll add the runbook entry and link the alert templates in the runbook. If anything fails during the next 24h, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
